findings.highlight: My body tells me I’m at my limit
findings.evidenceJa: 教会からこっち、なんとか続いていた体力
findings.governingReading: the stamina that had somehow held out since the church now declares its limit
findings.explanation: The duration and barely sustained escape effort are omitted.

findings.highlight: I move away from Saber
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーに借りていた肩から離れて
findings.governingReading: he moves away from the shoulder Saber had lent him for support
findings.explanation: Their precise supportive bodily relation is generalized.

findings.highlight: Even though the pain is gone
findings.evidenceJa: 痛みこそ薄れているものの
findings.governingReading: although the pain has weakened
findings.explanation: Reduced pain is changed into complete absence.

findings.highlight: Saber crouches and looks into my chest
findings.evidenceJa: しゃがみ込んで胸を覗きこんでくるセイバー
findings.governingReading: Inactive commented description in the bound Japanese, not part of the active source text.
findings.explanation: mirror moon activates an obsolete wound-inspection action.

findings.highlight: digs into it
findings.evidenceJa: 体の中に手を
findings.governingReading: puts her hand into his body—
findings.explanation: A deliberately interrupted action is completed early and given a more violent verb.

findings.highlight: mercilessly digs into me
findings.evidenceJa: 体の中をまさ、ぐ
findings.governingReading: feels/probes around inside his body
findings.explanation: Exploratory touch becomes digging.

findings.highlight: She’s digging into me with her bare hands
findings.evidenceJa: 素手で内臓に触れられている
findings.governingReading: Her bare hand is touching his internal organs.
findings.explanation: The specific visceral contact is replaced by a repeated generic digging action.

findings.highlight: pain seems to disappear around the places Saber touches
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーに触れられているところを中心にして、痛みが和らいでいく
findings.governingReading: the pain eases outward from the place where Saber is touching him
findings.explanation: One center of relief becomes multiple touched places, and easing becomes disappearance.

findings.highlight: That’s ridiculous. There’s no way.
findings.evidenceJa: 馬鹿な。そんな突拍子もない話が
findings.governingReading: The active response begins “Impossible. Such an absurd story…”; the alternate line is inactive.
findings.explanation: mirror moon presents both response variants, creating duplicated revision debris.

findings.highlight: He must have thought that it would be more useful for him to keep it
findings.evidenceJa: 切嗣はそれを私に返すより、自身が持っていた方が有利と判断したのでしょう
findings.governingReading: Kiritsugu probably judged it more advantageous to keep it than return it to Saber
findings.explanation: Saber’s reconstruction is strengthened toward certainty and “more useful” weakens the tactical comparison.

findings.highlight: Father
findings.evidenceJa: 切嗣も
findings.governingReading: written “Kiritsugu,” read “the old man/Father”
findings.explanation: The line’s simultaneous personal name and filial register are reduced to the reading alone.

findings.highlight: I accepted death, looking up at the sky
findings.evidenceJa: 曇った空を見上げながら死を受け入れた
findings.governingReading: he accepted death while looking up at the clouded sky
findings.explanation: The overcast visual setting of Shirou’s death memory is omitted.

findings.highlight: maybe it really was burned to ashes
findings.evidenceJa: 本当に黒こげだったのかもしれない
findings.governingReading: perhaps he truly had been charred black
findings.explanation: A tentative visual condition becomes more complete bodily destruction.

findings.highlight: He must have saved that dying life
findings.evidenceJa: 彼は、死にかけた命を救ったのか
findings.governingReading: Did he save the dying child’s life that way?
findings.explanation: Shirou’s emerging inference becomes strong certainty.

findings.highlight: until magical energy is channeled into it
findings.evidenceJa: 私が現界し、魔力を注がなければ
findings.governingReading: unless Saber is manifested and pours magical energy into it
findings.explanation: The required manifestation and Saber’s agency in supplying power are omitted.

findings.highlight: if any magical energy is in it
findings.evidenceJa: 魔力さえ注げば
findings.governingReading: if magical energy is supplied to it
findings.explanation: An active supply condition becomes passive presence of any amount.

findings.highlight: Your sheath was used for something like this
findings.evidenceJa: おまえの鞘を、こんな事で使っちまって
findings.governingReading: I’m sorry we used your sheath for something like this.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s apologetic acknowledgment of agency becomes passive voice.

findings.highlight: I have to look away
findings.evidenceJa: 思わず顔を逸らしてしまった
findings.governingReading: he involuntarily ends up looking away
findings.explanation: An involuntary embarrassed reaction becomes necessity.

findings.highlight: There’s nothing wrong with you
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーは何も悪くない
findings.governingReading: Saber has done nothing wrong.
findings.explanation: Moral reassurance about her action becomes reassurance about her condition.

findings.highlight: Her murmur sounds more like a confession. Saber apologizes to a person she cannot apologize to anymore
findings.evidenceJa: 懺悔に似ていた。セイバーはもう謝れない相手に言葉をかけ
findings.governingReading: Her murmur resembles confession as she addresses words to someone to whom she can no longer apologize.
findings.explanation: Confession-like address is promoted into the completed act of apologizing.

findings.highlight: she looks at me
findings.evidenceJa: こうして自らを見つめている
findings.governingReading: she is looking into/confronting herself like this
findings.explanation: The object of Saber’s introspection is reversed from herself to Shirou.

findings.highlight: She doesn’t say anything
findings.evidenceJa: それは言葉にしなくても
findings.governingReading: Even without putting that inward feeling into words.
findings.explanation: A qualification on what need not be verbalized becomes a claim that Saber says nothing during spoken dialogue.

findings.highlight: My heart understands
findings.evidenceJa: 確かに心に響いてくる
findings.governingReading: it resonates unmistakably in his heart
findings.explanation: Emotional resonance becomes cognition.

findings.highlight: if she could redo the selection
findings.evidenceJa: 剣を引き抜く時からやり直せたのなら
findings.governingReading: if she could start over from the moment she pulled out the sword
findings.explanation: A precise temporal scene is generalized into an abstract selection process.

findings.highlight: continued to deceive myself
findings.evidenceJa: 必死に自身を偽り続けてきた
findings.governingReading: had desperately continued deceiving herself
findings.explanation: The sustained desperation of Saber’s self-deception is omitted.

findings.highlight: days that were not to be wished for
findings.evidenceJa: 叶えられない日々
findings.governingReading: days that could never be realized/fulfilled
findings.explanation: Impossibility is changed into normative undesirability.

findings.highlight: just a passing dream
findings.evidenceJa: 一時の理想郷だった
findings.governingReading: a temporary “utopia,” read as a fleeting “dream”
findings.explanation: The written utopia and its double-layer relation to the dream are omitted.

findings.highlight: What should I feel, listening to her?
findings.evidenceJa: それを、どんな気持ちで聞けただろう
findings.governingReading: With what feelings could he have listened to that?
findings.explanation: Retrospective uncertainty about his actual reception becomes a prospective question about correct feeling.

findings.highlight: has decided to follow her oath until the very end
findings.evidenceJa: 最後まで守り通すと頷いた
findings.governingReading: she nodded that she would keep her oath through to the end
findings.explanation: Saber’s communicated assent and the completion of keeping the oath are weakened.

findings.highlight: I have loved her
findings.evidenceJa: 今のセイバーを愛した
findings.governingReading: he loved Saber as she is now
findings.explanation: The culmination in love for Saber’s present, resolved self is generalized.

findings.highlight: throwing aside my attachment and my selfishness
findings.evidenceJa: 未練を断って、自分の我が儘を蹴飛ばして
findings.governingReading: severing his lingering attachment and kicking away his selfish desire
findings.explanation: Two distinct violent acts of self-denial are flattened into one generic gesture.

findings.highlight: Saber nods in response
findings.evidenceJa: 力強く頷くセイバー
findings.governingReading: Saber nods powerfully.
findings.explanation: The strength with which Saber returns Shirou’s decision is omitted.

findings.highlight: suppress my heart, telling me I don’t want this
findings.evidenceJa: 崩れそうになるまなじりを、懸命に抑える
findings.governingReading: desperately restrains the corners of his eyes, which threaten to collapse as he thinks “I don’t want this”
findings.explanation: A visible struggle not to break into tears is relocated to an abstract heart.

findings.highlight: There’s no time to stop
findings.evidenceJa: 回り道はなしだ
findings.governingReading: There will be no detour.
findings.explanation: A decision to take the direct route becomes time pressure against stopping.
